# atproto_tangled_follow (Resource)

Follows an account on Tangled.

Manages a `sh.tangled.graph.follow` record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atproto_account" "bob" {
  handle = "bob.bsky.social"
}

resource "atproto_tangled_follow" "bob" {
  subject = data.atproto_account.bob.did
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subject` (String) DID of the account to follow.

### Optional

- `created_at` (String) Record creation time. Defaults to the time the record is created.
- `rkey` (String) Record key. The PDS generates a TID when this is not set.

### Read-Only

- `cid` (String) CID of the current version of the record.
- `id` (String) AT URI of the record.
- `uri` (String) AT URI of the record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A record key, or an AT URI.
tofu import atproto_tangled_follow.bob 3lyvqfkzktj2s
```
